facets.description: parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 5-11: the computed keys in minimumTokenResponseSchema both become "[object Object]" and collide. The schema validates only access_token and strips every other field (expiry, refresh_token, etc.).
parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 25-27: when refresh_token is missing, the literal string "refresh_token" is put in its place.
The placeholder injection is not limited to the sharing branch, so it also runs when credential sharing is off.
Callers such as office365calendar CalendarService.ts:263 save the placeholder over the user's real refresh token, which corrupts the credential.
